segments.name: biopharmaceutical sector
segments.description: Researches, develops and commercializes melanocortin-based treatments, mainly the SCENESSE® drug for adult EPP patients.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating segment: the biopharmaceutical sector.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for SCENESSE® implants sold in the United States and Europe, and for supply under special access reimbursement programs.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue from contracts with customers is derived primarily from the sale of SCENESSE® implants in the United States and Europe, as well as from sales under special access reimbursement programs.
